notes: Heading ἐντελεῖται on *charge* rather than *give* follows rule 91's support-verb line (μαρτυρέω → *bear witness* on *witness*, εὐχαριστέω → *give thanks* on *thanks*); a head on *give* remains defensible.
τοῦ of the articular infinitive is unrepresented under rule 61, no preposition governing it, so the infinitival *to* is the verb's own helper.
